Subject: HIPAA / BAA eligibility - Medwise Health

Hi Laura / Medwise security team —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can get this into procurement: 

1) Summary of ask
- Medwise indicated they will send PHI (patient names, limited identifiers) to Redwood for a note-generation workflow.
- Procurement needs confirmation on BAA availability, which deployment modes are eligible for handling PHI, and a completed vendor security questionnaire.

2) What Redwood can provide (high-level)
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and is currently in progress for SOC 2 Type II with an expected completion in Q3 2026. We can provide the SOC workpapers and interim controls report for procurement to review.
- BAA: We offer a standard Business Associate Agreement for customers who will process PHI. Availability and eligible deployment modes are below.
- PHI handling boundaries: For BAA customers we offer configuration and contractual controls to prevent PHI from being used for training and to limit logging/persistence. See details in attached security overview.

3) Eligible deployment modes for PHI (short answer)
- Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) — Eligible
- Private (VPC / on-prem) — Eligible
- Hosted shared API (public multi-tenant) — Not eligible for PHI / BAA at this time

4) Next steps (requested from Medwise)
- Please send your vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — you mentioned you would share the sheet.
- Confirm whether you need Redwood to host keys (KMS) or if you will bring your own.
- Provide target timeline for procurement signature / go-live.

Attachments: call-notes-20260712.txt (internal), Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf (high-level).

I’ll loop in Monica from our security team to help with the VSA and BAA language. Happy to hop on a short call with procurement if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@medwise-health.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HIPAA / BAA eligibility - Medwise Health

Hi Laura —

Thanks for sharing the VSA. I’m Monica (Security & Compliance) — I’ll own the questionnaire responses and the initial BAA draft. Quick answers to the items you called out and what we’ll attach/send next: 

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood: SOC 2 Type II is targeted for completion end of Q3 2026. We can provide interim SOC workpapers and our latest controls matrix today for procurement to review. If procurement requires the final Type II report, we’ll include expected delivery dates in the HubSpot deal notes (linked).

2) BAA availability and scope
- We do provide a BAA for customers processing PHI. Scope / constraints:
  - Eligible deployment modes for PHI under BAA: Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Private (VPC or on-prem).
  - Hosted (shared) API is not eligible for PHI handling and therefore not covered by the BAA.
  - For Dedicated and Private deployments we offer contractual assurances that PHI is not used to improve models, and we can disable long-term logging of request content upon request.

3) PHI handling boundaries / technical controls
- Data isolation: Dedicated customers get isolated GPU pools and tenant-level KV cache isolation.
- Encryption: All data in transit is TLS; at-rest encryption via customer-managed KMS is available for Private deployments and can be enabled for Dedicated.
- Auditability: Audit logs for request/response access and admin actions are available and can be retained per contract.

4) Next artifacts we’ll share
- Draft_BAA_Redwood.docx (for your legal redline)
- Completed VSA (we’ll return the filled spreadsheet within 2 business days)
- SOC interim package and controls matrix (attached: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf)

Questions for you
- Do you plan to bring your own KMS/HSM or need Redwood-managed keys for the Dedicated deployment?
- Any additional regions/data residency constraints we should be aware of?

I’ll start filling the VSA today and will upload the responses back to you. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute session with your procurement team to walk through the BAA and the SOC artifacts.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf]
[Attachment: Draft_BAA_Redwood.docx]

Monica / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity on deployment modes. A few follow-ups: 

- Please send the Draft_BAA_Redwood.docx into DocuSign once our legal team signs the redline — we typically use DocuSign for BAAs.
- We’ll review the SOC interim package — if procurement needs the final Type II, we’ll evaluate timing against our go-live.
- Confirming: Dedicated is our preferred route. Can your solutions engineering team provide an estimated timeline and sizing guidance for a Dedicated deployment (GPU types, expected latency, onboarding plan)?

We’ve attached the completed security questionnaire with a handful of procurement-specific fields for your legal/security to review. Looking forward to the returned VSA and the draft BAA. If possible, can we lock a 30-minute call early next week to walk through any outstanding items?

Thanks,
Laura
